consent_basis: COCO val2017 is published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). No biometric data nor personal data is processed — clips are derived from still photographic frames annotated with COCO bounding-box and keypoint labels; individuals cannot be re-identified from 3-second 640x480 synthetic clips with no audio. The dataset is used exclusively for model accuracy evaluation on an air-gapped developer machine and is never stored on production infrastructure.
permitted_uses: regression testing of face/object detection pipelines
CI quality gate on ExamOS developer workstations
retention_policy: Evaluation clips and labels are retained only on the developer workstation that generated them (gitignored path tests/p4/dataset/). They are deleted after the CI run completes or within 30 days, whichever is sooner. No copies are uploaded to cloud storage or included in release artefacts.
deletion_process: Automated: the CI workflow removes the tests/p4/dataset/ tree via 'rm -rf' at the end of the P4 job. Manual deletion instructions are in SECURITY.md §Dataset Lifecycle.
annotation_protocol: Ground-truth labels are derived mechanically from COCO 2017 instance and person-keypoint annotations (no human re-labelling). Label rules: single_face = exactly one person with nose and both eyes visible (keypoint visibility 2); multiple_faces = two or more such persons; no_face = image with no person instance annotation; phone_present = COCO cell-phone category 77, non-crowd; book_present = COCO book category 84, non-crowd.

label_schema.single_face: boolean — exactly one person keypoint annotation with nose and both eyes visible (visibility 2)
label_schema.multiple_faces: boolean — two or more such persons in the same crop
label_schema.no_face: boolean — no COCO person instance annotation present
label_schema.phone_present: boolean — at least one non-crowd COCO category-77 (cell phone) bounding box
label_schema.book_present: boolean — at least one non-crowd COCO category-84 (book) bounding box

train_validation_test_separation: This dataset is used exclusively as an evaluation (test) set. No model training or fine-tuning is performed on these clips. The COCO val2017 split is structurally disjoint from COCO train2017 which was used to train YOLOX.
human_review_scope: Any change to the annotation protocol, label schema, or permitted-use list requires sign-off by the SPPIO Privacy Officer before the modified dataset is used in a CI run.
